categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the design, development, manufacturing, and sales of data communication products including Ethernet switches, routers, wireless communication devices, and automotive electronic products. Its main revenue is derived from Ethernet switches, accounting for approximately 77% of total revenue, with additional income from routers, wireless products, and automotive electronics. The company serves enterprise-level and operator markets, with a focus on ODM/OEM cooperation models.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced communication technologies such as Ethernet switching, routing, Wi-Fi 7, and industrial TSN (Time-Sensitive Networking). It employs flexible and intelligent manufacturing platforms with automation and AI-driven process improvements, including automated packaging and testing. The company also develops products based on domestic and international chipsets, including Broadcom and Marvell, and focuses on high-performance data center switches, industrial switches, and automotive telematics modules.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic network equipment brand vendors such as H3C (New H3C Group), Ruijie Networks, and overseas clients mainly from Japan and South Korea like BUFFALO. The company’s products serve enterprise networks, data centers, telecommunications operators, and automotive electronics sectors. The domestic market dominates sales, accounting for over 99%, with growing overseas market penetration.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations and sales are primarily concentrated in China, especially in Shenzhen and other domestic regions. It has begun expanding into overseas markets, notably Japan and South Korea, with increasing export sales. The company maintains manufacturing and R&D facilities in Shenzhen, Zhejiang, and Wuhan, supporting its domestic and international business.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream of the supply chain as a manufacturer and ODM/OEM service provider for network equipment and automotive electronics. It collaborates closely with brand vendors who handle product design and marketing, while the company focuses on product development, manufacturing, and supply chain management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes dual-wheel development of communication network equipment and intelligent computing (AI-driven) products, including mid-to-high-end data center switches, servers, and DPU acceleration cards. It invests heavily in R&D to enhance domestic chipset integration, AI network capabilities, and automotive electronics innovation. The company prioritizes AI for network integration, 5G-A technology, and industrial IoT applications, with continuous patent development and technology upgrades.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of hardware products such as switches, routers, wireless devices, and automotive electronic modules. The company operates mainly on a direct sales model, including VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory) arrangements with major customers. It also earns investment income from financial assets and government subsidies related to R&D and production.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major domestic and international network equipment providers including H3C, Huawei, Cisco, and Ruijie Networks. It positions itself as a specialized ODM/OEM manufacturer with strong R&D capabilities and flexible production, focusing on enterprise and operator markets. The company has established stable partnerships with leading brand vendors, securing a significant market share in China’s enterprise network equipment sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.68 billion, a 19% decrease from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 117 million. Despite a revenue decline, the company maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 2.3 billion and continues to invest in R&D, with expenditures exceeding RMB 147 million. The company shows a stable but cautious growth trajectory amid challenging market conditions and increasing competition.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product reliability, stability, and quality, supported by strict quality management systems and certifications (ISO9001, IATF16949, ISO14001, ISO45001, ISO/IEC27001). It differentiates through flexible and intelligent manufacturing, strong R&D capabilities, and customized solutions integrating domestic chipsets and AI technologies. Its dual focus on communication connectivity and computing power products aims to meet evolving market demands for intelligent, high-performance network infrastructure.
